d: Jet black, long hair with straight bangs and two braided locks framing the face. Golden, almond-shaped eyes with a sharp, confident expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender, athletic build wearing a red and black ensemble consisting of a black bikini, a long red overcoat with black lining and silver buckles, and thigh-high black boots with red accents. Signature details include a small pirate hat with a white feather, black straps with silver anchor charms around the thighs, and two massive, mechanical red-and-black clawed arms floating behind the back.
